args.body: Hi Imogen, I'm sorry: our earlier message saying the fence and oven were fixed and closed was wrong, and we had no confirmation of that. I've reopened them as separate jobs: the oven, the fence, and your leaking conservatory roof (which we hadn't logged). To help with the roof, could you tell us where it is leaking, how much, and whether water is near any electrics or lights? If it is near electrics, please keep away and switch that circuit off if safe. We'll ask the landlord about the roof and fence and arrange the oven visit, and will update you by 2026-08-28.
